description: This Kotlin file defines a ViewModel class for an Android application that manages UI state for a home screen. It handles loading categories, banners, and their respective states, exposing data via StateFlow. It includes data classes for representing UI state, as well as methods to trigger data loading and handle success or failure cases.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state of a single content rail, including loading indicator, error message, and list of items.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the home screen's content categories and banners, providing functions to load or refresh data and exposing StateFlow observables.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Triggers simultaneous loading of all categories and banners.

methods.name: loadBanners
methods.description: Fetches banner images asynchronously and updates state, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Fetches a specific category's content items asynchronously, updating UI state accordingly.
